status: Declared after inspecting V1 retrospective results; no untouched claim for repeated 2023-2025 evaluation
problemObserved: V1 fixed older population adjustment understates held-later FBS-FCS net success by 2.804 percentage points, exceeding the unchanged two-point engineering target. Bias grows across 2023-2025 while FBS-FBS mean residual is near zero.
hypothesis: Let current-season completed-game evidence update the general venue/subdivision context around an older learned prior, without importing any previous team rating or a manually chosen gap.

model.objective: sum(netRate - effectA + effectB - H*venue - D*divisionSign)^2 + ridge*sum(effect^2) + contextPriorStrength*((H-homePrior)^2 + (D-divisionPrior)^2)
model.solution: Exact joint ridge solution via Schur complement; prior has zero previous-team-season effects. Current H and D are learned only from the eligible current-season past graph.
model.units: Same net success-rate units as V1; current team total is effect +/- D/2. No PPA value or human ranking input.
model.explanation: Conditional per-game normal-equation contributions reconcile every team score; report separate context normal equations and population prior. Current display subtracts the measured-FBS mean and multiplies by 100.
model.noFuture: Preweek H/D posterior uses the same target-excluded, full-parent-week plus 24h-buffer past graph as effects. No same-week statistics or later game may enter either fit.

selection.criterion: Pooled FBS-involving future-week MSE on 2018-2019; tie smaller ridge then stronger context prior
selection.baseline: Compare the already declared V1 adjusted/zero-division models and the independently selected three-column calibrated shrunken raw control. Whole-model comparison; no claim that gains isolate opponent adjustment or adaptation causally.
selection.supplementalTiming: Advanced success-rate fields for 2021-2022 have not been requested or inspected when this extension is declared. They are supplementary retrospective evidence, with familiar outcomes and later-corrected coverage, not a prospective trial.
selection.currentOrder: The original V1 file exists but current order has not selected V2 parameters; compute V2 current ranking only after older-only selection.

source.inherit: Same exact identities, ID-linked aliases, positive plays, integer-success reconciliation, mirror checks and provider-covered-play caveats as V1
source.rawRetention: Reuse locally held recipient key; transfer only encrypted raw envelopes. Keep decrypted sources and normalized arrays in ignored private caches.

checks.coverage: At least 98% paired eligible FBS games per evaluation year, complete saved-current FBS coverage
checks.math: Joint-normal-equation proof, finite stable solve, exact score and displayed-reference reconciliation
checks.pooledBias: Retain absolute FBS-oriented cross-subdivision mean error at most 0.02 for both repeated and supplementary year pools; report every year separately
checks.performance: Report RMSE/MAE/MSE against all frozen V1 controls, including subgroup/year regressions
checks.uncertainty: Paired season-type/week-block sensitivity intervals with original 1000 replicates/seed1729; repeated teams connect weeks, so no calibrated significance/prospective confidence claim
checks.interpretation: A failed check remains failed. No threshold change or silent auto-promotion of SOR/predictive. Any future Performance view must retain scrimmage-consistency scope and experimental retrospective status.
